faqs.question: How do I book an appointment at Mangal Anand Hospital?
faqs.answer: Use the appointment button or call 9508655628. The team will help you choose a convenient consultation time.

faqs.question: What services does Mangal Anand Hospital offer?
faqs.answer: Mangal Anand Hospital supports patients with Emergency Care, Specialist Consultation, Inpatient Care, Preventive Health Checkups, Surgical Care, Pharmacy Support.

faqs.question: Can I ask questions before visiting?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can call, email, or use WhatsApp to ask about availability, services, and the best next step for your needs.

faqs.question: Where is the clinic located?
faqs.answer: Mangal Anand Hospital is located at Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
